Partly. The JRC map doesn't show the loss itself. It is a 2020 forest/non-forest reference, so it can't record a 2023 event. What it does show is that the area that later lost cover was forest in 2020, and it agrees over 100% of the event area.

The 2023 loss comes from Hansen/UMD: about 0.7 ha (1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset). Because later years were also observed and JRC agrees, the loss is corroborated under the method (status SUPPORTED).

The MGAP 2021 map shows the area as mostly planted eucalyptus (0.4 ha), with 0.3 ha outside mapped forest and no native forest.

This doesn't establish deforestation, cause, legality, responsibility, or compliance. Hansen loss includes plantation harvest. A further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.
